newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tri-M in multi-million dollar buyout.
newsitem.headline: Tri-M in multi-million dollar buyout.

text.p: Electronics firm Tri-M Technologies (S) Ltd (Tri-M) said in statement on Monday that it was subject to a multi-million takeover bid from Surreyville Pte Ltd.
Tri-M said it had been notified that Surreyville had agreed sale and purchase deals with Mitsubishi Corp and Miyoshi Electronics Corp for their combined 14 million shares in the firm.
The purchase at U.S.$1.10 per share, agreed on January 17, represents 46.6 percent of Tri-M's share capital, the statement said.
Tri-M said it had been further notified by Surreyville that it would make a cash offer of Singapore $0.80 for each of Tri-M's remaining 16 million shares.
